name: state
meaning: FireBall_SetState's state: 0 = hidden, waiting for msg 0x5981 (a victim to burn); 1 = burning over the victim until the hit animation ends (Update)

name: flameTick
meaning: frame counter of the flame sprites: the frame is flameTick/2, and the three offsets are re-rolled when it passes the sprite's frameCount (RenderFlames)

name: flameOffsets
meaning: offsets of the three flame sprites from pos, re-rolled on entering state 1 and at each wrap of flameTick

name: flameSprite
meaning: the flame sprite sheet (resource 0xd0, AnimSprite_InitFromRes in PostLoadInit)
